title: Serve a Claude asset's file sandboxed from its own origin, its network closed or open by a context the server decides

tasks.title: Content served sandboxed with the public or the signed shiur policy, on its own origin

acs.text: WHEN anyone asks for a version's public URL, `GET /api/v1/claude-assets/content/{versionId}` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer the stored bytes as `text/html; charset=utf-8` with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer` and a `Content-Security-Policy` that starts with `sandbox allow-scripts`, has `frame-ancestors` listing exactly the origins in `SOCIAL_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (`'none'` when unset), `default-src 'none'`, inline script and style, images and media from `data:` and `blob:` only, and no `connect-src`
scenarios: AC-001 the public URL is sandboxed and closed

acs.text: WHILE `ASSET_TRUSTED_CDNS_ENABLED` is `true` THE SYSTEM SHALL add each host in `ASSET_TRUSTED_CDNS` (default `cdnjs.cloudflare.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net, unpkg.com, fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com`) as `https://<host>` to `script-src`, `style-src` and `font-src` of the public policy; while it is anything else (the default is off) no host is added
scenarios: AC-002 the trusted CDN list is a switch

acs.text: WHEN a version is pinned in a shiur (spec 063) THE SYSTEM SHALL give it, in the shiur's answer, a shiur URL `GET /api/v1/claude-assets/content/{versionId}/shiur/{grant}` whose grant names the shiur and an expiry and is signed with `ASSET_CONTENT_SECRET`; that URL SHALL answer the same bytes with the open policy (`sandbox allow-scripts`, the same `frame-ancestors`, and every source allowed); a grant that is unsigned, signed for another version, expired, or for a shiur that no longer pins this version SHALL be 404
scenarios: AC-003 the shiur URL is signed, short-lived and open

acs.text: WHEN `ASSET_CONTENT_ORIGIN` is set and a content URL is asked for on any other origin THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 404; every `contentUrl` the API gives is built on `ASSET_CONTENT_ORIGIN`
scenarios: AC-004 content lives on its own origin

acs.text: WHEN the asset is hidden or deleted, or the version is unknown THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 404 at both URLs; the public URL SHALL be cacheable for at most 5 minutes (`public, max-age=300`) and the shiur URL only privately
scenarios: AC-005 taken down, deleted or unknown, and caching

acs.text: WHEN anyone asks for an asset (`GET /api/v1/claude-assets/{assetId}`) or saves one THE SYSTEM SHALL give each version its public `contentUrl`
scenarios: AC-006 the API gives each version its content URL
